title: Alchemical Dagger
description: A sword-like item that multiplies your drops!
body:
Alchemical Dagger introduces a powerful progression-focused weapon infused with ritual magic and alchemical energy.


Through careful crafting, kills, and ritual empowerment, your dagger grows stronger — rewarding dedication, experimentation, and mastery.

This mod is designed to be overpowered in its nature but it has a config file in case you want to tweak it to be less powerful!

It comes with a manual, the "Codex", in case you need a bit of help to learn how to be a powerful alchemist... or at least a guy with a powerful alchemist weapon...

This was made for Forge Minecraft v1.20.1 (Forge version 47.4.10). Not thinking about making a port to Fabric. I just thought about this as a fun project I made cause I love the game and I love being overpowered (in a progressive environment).

Maybe Ill add stuff in the future or maybe not. Otherwise, I hope you enjoy my OP mod ladies and gents <3
